limitations: Mapped street centre lines are authentic OSM references; all widths, levels and road surface details are approximations.
A/B connect original dead arms to redesigned hairpins; native v08 race geometry is preserved.
Roads continue behind temporary racing closures; their presence is not race access authorization.
Unmapped private driveways and any changes since the OSM capture are not reconstructed.

native_geometry.method: Exact polygon terrain cut and5m surrounding grade; same XY and native edge level at racing surface; closed street surfaces behind barriers.
